name: How should a homeowner prepare before bathroom waterproofing begins?

mainEntity.name: How should a homeowner prepare before bathroom waterproofing begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before the contractor arrives, clear all personal toiletries, shower curtains, and shelving from the space, and establish an open path from the home entrance to the work area. Homeowners should also document any existing leaks, draft issues, or past repairs to discuss during the initial site assessment. If your project involves moving plumbing fixtures, changing from a tub to a walk-in shower, or adding accessibility features, clarify those requirements upfront so the contractor can coordinate sub-trades and inspect underlying joists and rough plumbing before installing backer boards.
acceptedAnswer.description: Remove personal items from the bathroom, clear a pathway for crews, and identify any known leak areas, layout adjustments, or plumbing changes for the contractor.
